data.body: AC2 regression evidence: `tests/unit/test_windows_text_encoding.py` (11 tests) run against the pre-fix tree: 11 failed (hook write `EncodingWarning: 'encoding' argument not specified` at hatch_build.py:112; stale-cp1252 read `UnicodeDecodeError ... 0x97`; `rebar explain plan` under PYTHONIOENCODING=cp1252 exited 1 with UnicodeEncodeError; `_use_utf8_stdio` absent; all 5 CLI-consumer modules had text-mode `run` calls without `encoding`; bindings write produced `\r\n` under `_pyio` + `os.linesep="\r\n"`). After the fix: 11 passed. All 133 deselected tests plus the touched modules: 849 passed locally. `ruff check --preview --select PLW1514 src scripts`: All checks passed. Commit d9a9f3b5b6f (stacked on the leafy/citreous/arctic commits) deletes text-encoding.args and its test.yml reference. Not addressed (out of the plan's scope, not implicated in any listed failure): `src/rebar/_store/gitutil.py:199,229` and `src/rebar/attest/sshsig.py:51` still run git/ssh with `text=True` and no encoding.
